resources.string: For foldables whose hinge sensor has failed (for example a loose or damaged flex cable), so the phone no longer switches screens when you fold it. Fold Toggle switches between the inner and outer screen on demand.
✗ No switchable outer-screen mode was found on this device. Please send a device report below so support can be added.
Switch screens from the always-on notification, the Quick Settings tile, or by long-pressing the app icon. Tap again on the outer screen to switch back.
Tap to switch back to the inner screen
Tap to use the outer screen
Fold Toggle: this device isn\'t supported yet
Fold Toggle couldn\'t switch screens on this Android version. Open the app and tap \"Report this device on GitHub\" so it can be fixed.
